senses.gloss:
उत्पक्ष्मन् उत्-पक्ष्मन्, आ, आ, अ, or उत्-
पक्ष्मल, अस्, आ, अम्, with upraised eyelids.

उत्पचिष्णु उत्-पचिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, apt to ripen
or cook.

उत्पट् उत्-पट् (उद्-प्˚), Caus. -पाटयति, -यि-
तुम्, to tear up or out, root up, eradicate, extirpate.
उत्-पट, अस्, m. sap issuing from the cleft of a tree.

उत्-पाट, अस्, m. pulling up by the roots, destroy-
ing; a disease of the external ear.

उत्-पाटक, अस्, m. the above disease; (इका), f. the
external bark of a tree.

उत्-पाटन, अम्, n. pulling up by the roots, eradi-
cating; destroying, destruction.

उत्-पाटित, अस्, आ, अम्, pulled up by the roots,
eradicated, torn out.

उत्-पाटिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (often at the end of compounds)
eradicating, extirpating.
उत्-पाट्य, ind. having plucked up.

उत्पत् उत्-पत् (उद्-प्˚), cl. 1. P. -पतति, -ति-
तुम्, to fly or jump up, to rise, to be produced, ori-
ginate: Caus. -पातयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fly up.

उत्-पत, अस्, m. a bird; going upwards or up.
—उत्पत-निपता, f. flying up and down.

उत्-पात, अस्, m. flying up, a spring, jump; an
unusual or startling event boding calamity, a portent,
prodigy, phenomenon; any public calamity, as an
eclipse, meteor, earthquake.
—उत्पात-वात, अस्, m. a
whirlwind, a hurricane.
उत्-पतत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, flying upwards or onwards.

उत्-पतन, अम्, n. rising, ascending, going up;
birth, production.
उत्-पतित, अस्, आ, अम्, springing up, risen, ascended.
उत्-पतितव्य अस्, आ, अम्, to be flown upwards.

उत्-पतितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, rising, jumping up, going
upwards.
उत्-पतिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, rising, jumping up.

उत्-पातक, अस्, m. a fabulous animal with eight
legs, (written also उत्-पादक, q. v.); N. of a Tīrtha.

उत्पताक उत्-पताक, अस्, आ, अम्, with raised
flags; with uplifted banners; (आ), f. a raised banner
or flag.
—उत्-पताक-ध्वज, अस्, आ, अम्, with raised
banners and flags.

उत्पथ उत्-पथ, अस्, m. wrong road, bad
way, error, evil; (अम्), ind. astray, on the wrong
road.

उत्पद् उत्-पद् (उद्-प्˚), cl. 4. A. -पद्यते,
-पत्तुम्, to arise, rise, originate, be produced:
Caus. -पादयति, -यितुम्, to produce, beget, gene-
rate, cause, effect; to cause to issue or come forth,
bring forward.

उत्-पत्ति, इस्, f. arising, birth, production, origin;
becoming visible, coming into existence; production
in general, profit, productiveness; producing as an
effect or result, giving rise to or generating as a con-
sequence; resurrection.
—उत्पत्ति-कालीअ, अस्, आ, अम्,
taking place at the time of birth.
—उत्पत्ति-प्रयोग,
अस्, m. production by the joint operation of cause and
effect; purport, meaning.
—उत्पत्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
produced, born.
—उत्पत्ति-व्यञ्जक, अस्, m. a type
of birth (as investiture); a mark of the twice-born.

उत्-पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, risen, gone up; arisen, born,
produced; produced unexpectedly; acquired, gained;
occurred, happened; effected, accomplished; known,
ascertained.
—उत्पन्न-तन्तु, उस्, उस्, उ, having a
line of descendants.
—उत्पन्न-त्व, अम्, n. origin,
production.
—उत्पन्न-भक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, living
from hand to mouth.
—उत्पन्न-विनाशिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
perishing as soon as produced.

उत्-पाद, अस्, m. coming forth, birth, production.
—उत्पाद-पूर्व, अम्, n. title of the first of the
fourteen Pūrvas or older sacred writings of the Jainas.
—उत्-पाद-शयन, see s. v. next col.

उत्-पादक, अस्, आ, अम्, bringing forth, producing,
productive, effective; (अस्), m. a producer, a genera-
tor; a fabulous animal, called Śarabha, with eight
legs; written also उत्पातक; (इका), f. a certain
insect, perhaps the white ant (termes); N. of the
pot-herb Enhydra Hingtsha, also of Basilla Rubra or
Lucida; (अम्), n. origin, cause.

उत्-पादन, अस्, आ, अम्, bringing forth, producing,
productive; (अम्), n. producing, generating, beget-
ting, causing.

उत्-पादित, अस्, आ, अम्, produced, effected; gene-
rated, begotten.

उत्-पादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, produced, born; (at the end
of compounds) bringing forth, producing.

उत्-पाद्य, ind. having produced; having begotten;
having inspired.

उत्-पाद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being produced or
generated.

उत्पल 1. उत्पल, अम्, n. (fr. rt. पल् for
पट् with उद्, to burst upwards as a blossom?), the
blue lotus, Nymphæa Cærulea, a seed of the Nym-
phæa; the plant Costus Speciosus; any water-lily; a
plant in general; (अस्), m., N. of a man who built a
sanctuary, of an astronomer; N. of a lexicographer;
(आ), f., N. of a river; (ई), f. a kind of cake made
with unwinnowed corn.
—उत्पल-गन्धिक, अम्, n.
a species of sandal of the colour of brass and very
fragrant.
—उत्पल-चक्षुस्, उस्, उस्, उस्, lotus-eyed,
fine-eyed.
—उत्पल-पत्त्र, अम्, n. the leaf of a
Nymphæa; a wound caused by the finger-nail of a
woman; a Tīlaka or mark on the forehead, made
with sandal &c. by the Hindūs; a broad-bladed
knife or lancet.
—उत्पल-पत्त्रक, अम्, n. a broad-
bladed knife or lancet used by surgeons.
—उत्पल-
पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town built by Utpala.
—उत्-
पल-भेद्यक, अस्, m. a kind of bandage.
—उत्पल-
माला, f., N. of a lexicon.
—उत्पल-राज, अस्, m., N.
of a poet.
—उत्पल-वती, f., N. of a river.
—उत्पल-
वर्णा, f., N. of a woman.
—उत्पल-शाक, अस्, m.,
N. of a plant.
—उत्पल-शारिवा, f. the plant Ichno-
carpus Frutescens.
—उत्पलाक्ष (˚ल-अक्˚), अस्, m.,
and उत्पलापीड (˚ल-आप्˚), अस्, m., N. of two princes.
—उत्पलाभ (˚ल-आभ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, lotus-like, re-
sembling a lotus.
—उत्पला-वन, अम्, n., N. of a
region in Pañcāla.

उत्पल 2. उत्-पल, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. उद् and
पल, flesh), fleshless, emaciated; (अम्), n., N. of
a hell.

उत्पलक, अस्, m., N. of a man; of a king of
the Nāgas.

उत्पलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, abounding in lotus flowers;
(इनी), f. an assemblage of lotus flowers; a species of
the Atijagatī metre, the same as Candrikā; N. of a
river; title of a dictionary.
उत्पवन उत्-पवन. See under उत्-पू.

उत्-पवन, अम्, n. cleaning, cleansing; straining
liquids for domestic or religious uses; any implement
for cleaning; the act of sprinkling clarified butter or
other fluids on the sacrificial fire with two blades of
Kuśa grass, the ends of which are held in either hand
and the centre dipped into the liquid.

उत्पश्य उत्-पश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, looking up or
upwards.

उत्पादशयन उत्-पाद-शयन, अस्, m. a kind
of partridge, Parra Jacana or Gœnsis, (sleeping with
legs erect.)

उत्पारण उत्-पारण, अम्, n., Ved. transport-
ing over, transportation.
उत्पाली उत्पाली, f. health (etym. doubtful).

उत्पिञ्जर उत्-पिञ्जर, अस्, आ, अम्, uncaged,
unconfined.

उत्-पिञ्जल, अस्, आ, अम् (ल् substituted for र्), out of
order, disordered, excessively confused; uncaged.

उत्पित्सु उत्-पित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ (Desid. of उत्-
पत्, q. v.), desirous of rising or flying away or pro-
ceeding.

उत्पिष् उत्-पिष् (उद्-प्˚), cl. 7. P. -पिनष्टि,
-पेष्टुम्, to rub together; to crush, grind.

उत्-पिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed, ground; (अम्), n.
a disease, a grating of the bones or of the joints upon
each other.

उत्पीड् उत्-पीड् (उद्-प्˚), cl. 10. P. -पीडयति,
-यितुम्, to press upwards, to press out of.

उत्-पीड, अस्, m. pressing out, pressure; foam,
froth, a gush.
उत्-पीडन, अम्, n. the act of pressing out.

उत्पुच्छय उत्-पुच्छय, nom. (fr. उद्-पुच्छ)
A. उत्पुच्छयते, to raise or cock the tail; P. -यति,
to make one raise the tail.

उत्पुटक उत्-पुटक, अस्, m. a disease of the
external ear; [cf. उत्-पाट.]

उत्पुलक उत्-पुलक, अस्, आ, अम्, joyful, de-
lighted.

उत्पू उत्-पू (उद्-पू), cl. 9. P. A. -पुनाति,
-पुनीते, -पवितुम्, to cleanse, purify; to extract
anything that has been purified.
उत्-पवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, purifying; a purifier.
उत्-पाव, अस्, m. purifying ghee &c.

उत्पोषध उत्-पोषध, अस्, m., N. of an old
king.

उत्प्रभ उत्-प्रभ, अस्, आ, अम्, flashing forth
or diffusing light, shining.
उत्प्रसव उत्-प्रसव, अस्, m. abortion.

उत्प्रास उत्-प्रास, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. अस् with
प्र and उद्), hurling, throwing afar; violent burst
of laughter; ridicule, derision; excess.
उत्-प्रासन, अम्, n. = the preceding.

उत्प्रुष् उत्-प्रुष्, ट्, f., Ved. that which bub-
bles up, a bubble.

उत्प्रेक्ष् उत्-प्रेक्ष् (उद्-प्र-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A.
-प्रेक्षते, -षितुम्, to look up to with attention
(as a pupil to his teacher); to perceive; to transfer
(with loc.); to compare one thing with another,
illustrate by a simile.

उत्-प्रेक्षण, अम्, n. looking into, perceiving,
foreseeing, comparing.

उत्-प्रेक्षा, f. overlooking, disregarding, careless-
ness, indifference; (in rhetoric) comparison in general,
simile, illustration, metaphor; a parable; an ironical
comparison.
—उत्प्रेक्षा-वल्लभ, अस्, m., N. of a
poet.
उत्-प्रेक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, compared (as in a simile).

उत्-प्रेक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, that with which anything
is compared.

उत्प्लु उत्-प्लु (उद्-प्˚), cl. 1. A. -प्लवते,
-प्लोतुम्, to jump up, leap up; to bound; to spring
or jump upon; to float upon.
उत्-प्लव, अस्, m. a jump, leap, bound; (आ), f. a boat.

उत्-प्लवन, अम्, n. jumping or leaping up, spring-
ing upon; skimming off impure oil or ghee, or any
dirt floating on a fluid, by passing a blade of Kuśa
grass over it.

उत्-प्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, jumped up or upon, sprung
upon suddenly.
उत्-प्लुत्य, ind. having sprung up or jumped upon.
उत्-प्रबाल, अस्, आ, अम्, shooting out fresh foliage.
